items.content_text: - **Prediction markets push into stock-linked contracts as Rothera wins CFTC approval for Tesla KPI swaps, Covers reports** — Covers reported October 29 that federally regulated prediction markets are adding contracts tied to stock indices, corporate earnings and industry performance to attract financial traders, with sports-related contracts still accounting for roughly 85 percent of trading volume.
